output.notes: Headline OLMo 2 base models (7B, 13B, 32B) described; block attributes use the 7B config. The 1B (Appendix: 16 layers, d_model 2048, 16/16 heads) is an experimentation-scale model and is not listed as a config. Sec. 2.1's equation writes h_out = h + RMSNorm(MLP(x)), but Sec. 3.3.2's table gives MLP(h), meaning a sequential, non-parallel block. That is what I used, and I treat the Sec. 2.1 form as a typo. QK-norm is RMSNorm on the key and query projections; the paper does not say whether it is per-head or full width, so I left it unspecified. Vocab size is not given: the tokenizer is cl100k plus extra masking tokens. Also not stated: head_dim, d_ff for 13B/32B (only the approximately 8/3·d rule rounded to a multiple of 128), norm eps, RoPE pairing, tied embeddings and any final norm before the head. Z-loss (training regularizer), weight decay and checkpoint souping are training details, not architecture.
